# Data Source: catalyst_stratus_object_versions

Read version IDs, latest flags and available metadata for one existing Stratus object in a versioned bucket. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.buckets.objects.READ`. Reads up to 100 pages of 100 versions and returns an error if more pages remain. Verified with offline protocol tests.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_stratus_object_versions" "existing" {
  project_id  = "123456789"
  bucket_name = "example-versioned-bucket"
  object_key  = "assets/config.json"
}

output "stratus_version_ids" {
  value = data.catalyst_stratus_object_versions.existing.versions[*].version_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Existing lowercase Stratus bucket name.
- `object_key` (String) Complete object key, including any folder prefix.
- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `versions` (Attributes List) Version records sorted by ID. A successful listing with zero versions returns an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `etag` (String) Opaque version ETag when reported.
- `is_latest` (Boolean) Whether Catalyst marks this version as the latest.
- `last_modified` (String) Last-modified value in the original service format when reported.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Version size in bytes when reported.
- `version_id` (String) Opaque version ID returned by Catalyst.
